upcoming.title: Truth Based Relationships Retreat
upcoming.description: Escape to the nature of Bali for a transformative retreat based on the Authentic Relationships Model by its author Psychologist Juan Andres Papagno Gazmuri. Learn to navigate connections with friends, partners, family and co-workers from a place of deep personal truth. Embodying your authentic self begins here.

upcoming.title: Regenerative Reset Retreat
upcoming.description: This 14-day immersive wellbeing journey is designed for anyone seeking balance and clarity through practices like yoga, breathwork, and nature connection. By blending philosophy with deep relaxation and sharing circles, the program offers a structured yet spacious environment to recalibrate your body and mind. No prior experience is required to join this path toward reconnection and self-understanding.

upcoming.title: Yoga & Culture Retreat
upcoming.description: Join us on this one-week exploration of Yoga and Balinese culture. This retreat is an invitation to slow down, breathe deeper, and reconnect with yourself through yoga, nourishing habits, and the beauty of authentic Balinese culture. Held in a peaceful setting surrounded by nature, it offers a gentle blend of movement, rest, mindful living, and meaningful cultural experiences — creating space for you to unwind, recharge, and return to what truly matters.

upcoming.title: Ecovillage Design Education (EDE)
upcoming.description: Join a global movement of changemakers in this 4-week immersive program certified by Gaia Education and recognized by UNESCO as a ‘Contributor to Education for Sustainable Development’. The EDE explores the four dimensions of sustainable community design: social, ecological, economic, and worldview. Through hands-on learning, field visits, and collaboration, participants design solutions for regenerative living

upcoming.title: Ecovillage Tours – Journey to Community
upcoming.description: Discover why Bali is an ideal site for ecovillage living. Join us for a 10-day immersive journey through Bali’s most inspiring eco-initiatives and community-led projects. This experiential tour offers a rare blend of cultural immersion, ecological learning, and spiritual connection. From bamboo architecture and permaculture farms to community-based conservation, you’ll meet visionary locals leading the way in regenerative living.

upcoming.title: Yoga  Teacher  Training Course (TTC)
upcoming.description: This 200-hour Yoga Alliance certified program with Bala Yoga School blends traditional wisdom with modern practice. Participants will deepen their understanding of asana, pranayama, meditation, chanting, anatomy, and yogic philosophy. Set in the tranquil surroundings of Alaya, this TTC offers a nurturing space to develop your personal practice and teaching skills.

items.text: An enriching month-long immersion into yoga practice and philosophy. This TTC guided students in developing a strong, injury-free self-practice and prepared them to teach with confidence and clarity. Mornings began with pranayama and chanting, followed by asana, meditation sessions, and integral yoga theory lessons: all in Alaya’s peaceful natural setting.

This series of 3-day workshops introduced participants to the principles of Ayurveda, focusing on personalized nutrition using local, affordable ingredients. The sessions included both theory and hands-on cooking, aiming to reconnect people with the healing potential of food. Delivered in English and Indonesian, the workshops supported local knowledge-sharing through scholarships.

The training took place four times over 3 days in 2024, with 4 - 6 participants including international students and local students. They were all level 1 trainings, giving a solid introduction to basic massage including techniques from Thai Yoga, Ayurveda and Siddha medecine.

The students were given a book to keep practicing until they would be ready for level 2.

This wellness-focused 5 day retreat combined plant-based nutrition, massage training, journaling techniques, and several other holistic therapies to promote deep healing. Guests engaged in self-care practices while learning from experienced facilitators in a setting of natural beauty and tranquility.

A 4 week transformative experience that brought together changemakers, educators, and ecologists from around the world. Participants engaged in hands-on design practices rooted in sustainability, systems thinking, and regenerative living. The 2024 and 2025 cohort left inspired to build communities that nurture both people and the planet. We also hosted a "Training of Trainers" in 2025 as many Indonesian and International participants were keen on moving into Gaia Education and facilitators training.

items.tab: Ecovillage Gathering & Dances of Universal Peace
items.text: We gathered, as members of the Global Ecovillage Network Asia Oceania, and those who were new and stepping into this community for the first time - in circle, for the heart centered celebration and cross-pollination event in Pemuteran, Bali. We danced for peace, and exchanged inspiration and ideas for win-win-win collaborations, seeding hope for the future.

Alaya Ecolodge hosted a Level 1 and Level 2 Authentic Relating Training - with its tools to transform relationships through communication. This two-part training offered a deep dive into presencing, vulnerability, and connection. Through interactive practices, participants learnt to speak their truth, listen deeply, and build real human bonds with themselves and others.

Alaya Ecolodge hosted a group from Ecovillage Tours. The group had come to discover why Bali is ideal for ecovillage living. On thier  10-day immersive journey through Bali’s inspiring eco-initiatives and community-led projects, they came to Pemuteran for their last days, to discover why this region is award wining for its "Eco-Tourism" initiatives.
